test.description: Test name as it appears in verify.json's failed list, or the function/describe name from the test body

status.description: real_break: dep changed behaviour the target depends on. over_specific: assertion pins something incidental. env: failure unrelated to dep version. weak: assertion would pass regardless of dep behaviour.

action.description: keep: test is correct as-is. weaken: assert only the part the target reads. drop: nothing useful remains. strengthen: replace shape check with concrete value. fix: repair environment/setup issue.

reasoning.description: Cite the assertion diff from verify.json output, the changelog line, or the surface.json call site that supports this verdict.

suggestion.description: For weaken/strengthen/fix: the concrete replacement assertion or the change to make.
